kjv.text: Think not that I am come to destroy the law, or the prophets: I am not come to destroy, but to fulfil.

web.text: Don't think that I came to destroy the law or the prophets. I didn't come to destroy, but to fulfill.

asv.text: Think not that I came to destroy the law or the prophets: I came not to destroy, but to fulfil.

kjv.text: But I say unto you, That ye resist not evil: but whosoever shall smite thee on thy right cheek, turn to him the other also.

web.text: But I tell you, don't resist him who is evil; but whoever strikes you on your right cheek, turn to him the other also.

asv.text: but I say unto you, Resist not him that is evil: but whosoever smiteth thee on thy right cheek, turn to him the other also.
